description: Left and right column blocks with a 10pt gutter (1 em at the page's 10pt font, above assemble.rs's em-relative MIN_GUTTER_EMS threshold, though below the old fixed 18pt page-fraction rule) and slightly different top-y positions. The right column's top edge sits a few points higher than the left's, so before adaptive gutter detection landed, no cut qualified and the naive top-y fallback read the right column entirely before the left -- a full column-order inversion. The em-relative vertical cut now fires and recovers left-before-right order.
